blocks.text: Primary record · not a teaching authority
An Islamic primary text on God's oneness and incomparability. Compare translations and commentary; an English rendering is not the Arabic text itself.
The held Pickthall translation is provided for comparison. It is a different edition from the Quran.com translations cited by the guide; it is not a Christian teaching authority.
Say: He is Allah, the One
Allah, the eternally Besought of all
He begetteth not nor was begotten
And there is none comparable unto Him
